metadata.description: Open the current project in Xcode from Claude Code

plugins.name: xed
plugins.description: Adds /xed, which opens the current project in Xcode the way `xed` does in the terminal — but it finds the right target for you, preferring the closest .xcworkspace, then .xcodeproj, then Package.swift. Pass --branch <name> to open the worktree that has that branch checked out, and --pull to fast-forward it first.
